hook: Six crew members clung to the wreckage, 30 miles out.
narration: Six crew members clung to what was left of their boat.
It sank thirty miles off the Dominican Republic.
A rescue basket lets a tired survivor just climb in while the crew does the lifting.
One at a time, all six came up into the Jayhawk.
Safe in the cabin, they rode to Puerto Plata.
outcome: All six were handed to medical crews in Puerto Plata and reported in good health.

location_card.place: North of Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic

title: Six clinging to wreckage 30 miles out
description:
On Dec. 13, 2023, a Coast Guard MH-60 Jayhawk crew with Operation Bahamas, Turks and Caicos found six mariners hanging on to the debris of their sunken vessel about 30 miles north of Puerto Plata, Dominican Republic, and hoisted all six aboard.
